title: TileCache: Serving Multi-Round Diffusion Image Editing with Compressed Activation Caches
abstract: arXiv:2611.20246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-round diffusion image editing can reduce computation by reusing intermediate activations, but retaining these activations across editing rounds introduces substantial memory and bandwidth overheads. Compression can reduce these overheads, but efficient cache construction is challenging: compressing only after editing requires buffering over 100 GB of activations per request. Moreover, the compressed cache must support selective reuse, as future masked edits require only a subset of the cached activations. It also exposes a scheduling challenge, as cached edits are faster than initial generations, causing naive policies to severely delay either initial generations or editing requests. In this paper, we aim to address both challenges through compression-informed serving. We develop TileCache, a serving system for multi-round diffusion editing. It compresses reusable activations and incorporates a scheduler that balances both edits

translated_title: TileCache：基于压缩激活缓存的多轮扩散图像编辑服务系统
translated_abstract: 多轮扩散图像编辑可以通过重用中间激活来减少计算量，但跨编辑轮次保留这些激活会引入大量的内存和带宽开销。压缩虽然可以减少这些开销，但高效的缓存构建充满挑战：如果仅在编辑完成后才进行压缩，则需要为每个请求缓冲超过100 GB的激活。此外，压缩后的缓存必须支持选择性重用，因为未来的掩码编辑只需要缓存激活中的一个子集。这还带来了调度方面的挑战：由于缓存编辑比初始生成更快，简单的调度策略会严重延迟初始生成请求或编辑请求。在本文中，我们旨在通过压缩感知的服务方式来应对这两个挑战。我们开发了TileCache，一个面向多轮扩散图像编辑的服务系统。它对可重用的激活进行压缩，并引入了一个能够在编辑请求之间实现平衡的调度器。
tldr: TileCache是一个面向多轮扩散图像编辑的服务系统，它通过压缩可重用激活来构建高效缓存，并设计压缩感知的调度器以平衡初始生成与缓存编辑请求，解决了中间激活缓存带来的内存开销与调度难题。
en_tdlr: TileCache is a serving system for multi-round diffusion image editing that compresses reusable activations into efficient caches and employs compression-informed scheduling to balance initial generations and cached edit requests, addressing the memory overhead and scheduling challenges of activation caching.
